title: 听力挑战 · 商务邮件沟通

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Did you attach the file to the email this morning?
rounds.lineCn: 你今天早上把文件附到邮件里了吗?

grammar.name: 介词 to 表对象
grammar.note: attach...to 是固定搭配,to 引出附件的接收对象。

options.text: Yes, I attached it to the second message.
options.feedback: attached to 搭配正确,明确回应。

options.text: No, the file is too large to print.
options.feedback: 谈打印困难,没有回应是否附上文件。

options.text: I emailed the team about the delay.
options.feedback: 谈通知团队延期,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 主管
rounds.line: To whom should we address this invoice in the end?
rounds.lineCn: 这张发票最后应该寄给谁?

grammar.name: 介词 to 表对象
grammar.note: address...to 表示'把……寄送给',to 后接对象。

options.text: Please send it to the finance department.
options.feedback: 明确寄送对象,to 的使用正确。

options.text: The invoice was sent last Friday.
options.feedback: 谈寄送时间,没有回答寄给谁。
谈写地址的动作,答非所问。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Have you replied to the client about the new deadline?
rounds.lineCn: 你就新的截止日期回复客户了吗?

grammar.name: 介词 within 与 before
grammar.note: within 表示'在……之内',before 表示'在……之前',表时间界限。

options.text: I replied within an hour, before the end of day.
options.feedback: within 与 before 使用准确,回复及时。

options.text: I will reply after the deadline.
options.feedback: 在截止日期之后回复,明显失当。

options.text: The client replied to our question.
options.feedback: 主客颠倒,是客户回复了我们。
